title: ZZWF07 four-round related-key equal-byte-difference property

target.description: Whitening followed by source rounds 1–4 including MixColumns in round4; equality is at x4O after ARK(k4), not a four-round reduced cipher with final MC removed.

setting.key_relation: First master-key XOR pattern Table2: active a at byte0 of word2 and word3; other master bytes zero. Nonzero a chosen, dependent b/c/d generated by the actual key schedule.
setting.key_population: General secret-key pair with the specified master-key XOR relation; no weak-key class is selected.
setting.plaintext_model: Plaintext XOR equals Delta k0=((0,0,0,0),(0,0,0,0),(a,0,0,0),(a,0,0,0)), canceling the initial whitening difference.
assumptions: This is the deterministic intermediate equality property, not the probabilistic last S-box layer or an end-to-end recovery success.

property.statement: With Table2 key differences and DeltaP=Delta k0, the four-round construction forces Delta x4O[1]=Delta x4O[2]=delta nonzero with probability one, as Eq.6.
property.quantifier: For every pair following the specified first master-key XOR pattern and matched plaintext difference, the intermediate byte equality follows deterministically from the bijective S-box and linear MixColumns map.
property.scope: Supporting four-round equal-difference property; it does not provide a whole-key-recovery probability, numerical attack resources, or a minimum-active-S-box bound.

parameters.name: active_difference
parameters.meaning: Nonzero chosen master-key and plaintext byte difference.

parameters.name: equal_difference
parameters.meaning: Resulting equal intermediate-byte difference; its actual value depends on key/plaintext.

validation.description: Read PDF6 Eq.6 and its complete byte propagation; independently checked the AES inverse/forward linear-coefficient reasoning and finite key-schedule Tables 2/3. No author attack or search code executed.

time.note: Supporting mathematical intermediate-state property, not a complete key-recovery resource.

data.note: Supporting mathematical intermediate-state property, not a complete key-recovery resource.

memory.note: Supporting mathematical intermediate-state property, not a complete key-recovery resource.

preprocessing.note: Supporting mathematical intermediate-state property, not a complete key-recovery resource.

success.description: A deterministic equality or a local parity-model bias is not an end-to-end key-recovery success probability.

evidence.locator: PDF5–6/printed77–78 Section4, Table2, byte propagation and Eq.6.
evidence.interpretation: Exact primary model and round boundaries checked; supporting property separated from key-recovery budgets.

limitations: Complete 13-page independent primary read and bounded forward-primary review on 2026-10-27. Finite S-box tuple, key-schedule, linear-map and source-exponent checks do not execute or reproduce the whole statistical recovery attack.
